items.title: 荷姆茲海峽戰火再起！美軍空襲伊朗 國際油價暴漲近4%
items.title_en: War Reignites in the Hormuz Strait! U.S. Airstrikes Iran, International Oil Prices Jump Nearly 4%
paras: 美軍周二(9/1)再度空襲伊朗，回應伊朗伊斯蘭革命衛隊(IRGC)近期企圖攻擊荷姆茲海峽商船及駐中東美軍。美伊一個多月來首度直接互相攻擊，推升國際油價大漲，西德州中級原油(WTI)期貨升至7月下旬以來最高。
美國中央司令部(CENTCOM)在社群平台證實，美軍已開始攻擊伊朗境內的革命衛隊目標。此前，兩艘油輪在荷姆茲海峽遇襲，其中一艘周一航行於靠近阿曼海岸的南側航道時，遭3枚不明物體擊中，所幸未傳出人員傷亡。
川普政府據報考慮採納CENTCOM提出的有限攻擊計畫，阻止伊朗重建可用於攻擊海峽船隻的雷達及飛彈能力。
美軍周日已攻擊位於荷姆茲海峽的伊朗拉拉克島兩座火箭發射器，據報造成3人死亡。華府稱，德黑蘭原本準備向海峽發射搭載水雷的的火箭。伊朗隨後於周一攻擊約旦境內兩座美軍基地作為報復。
美國總統川普(Donald Trump)警告，美方將「狠狠打擊」伊朗，並會對美軍基地遇襲作出回應。不過，分析人士認為，美軍只攻擊特定發射器，而未擴大打擊伊朗軍事設施，顯示華府現階段意在懲罰特定行為、維持封鎖，而非重啟全面戰爭。
伊朗總統裴澤斯基安(Masoud Pezeshkian)則表示，如果華府願意重新履行6月簽署的臨時協議，德黑蘭也會立即採取對等行動。雙方雖均未顯示有意恢復全面戰爭，但也表明將回應後續攻擊。
中東局勢升高帶動布蘭特原油期貨上漲3.8%，報每桶93.89美元；WTI期貨上漲3.7%至89.41美元，創7月24日以來最高。這場戰爭已進入第7個月，不僅擾亂全球能源供應，也持續衝擊金融市場。
持續更新...
paras_en: U.S. forces carried out another airstrike on Iran on Tuesday (Sept. 1), responding to recent attempts by the Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC) to attack commercial vessels in the Strait of Hormuz and U.S. forces stationed in the Middle East. This marks the first direct reciprocal attack between the United States and Iran in more than a month, pushing international oil prices sharply higher, with West Texas Intermediate (WTI) futures climbing to their highest level since late July.

U.S. Central Command (CENTCOM) confirmed on social media that American forces have begun striking IRGC targets inside Iran. Earlier, two tankers were attacked in the Strait of Hormuz; one of them was hit on Monday by three unidentified objects while navigating the southern lane near the Omani coast, but no casualties were reported.

Reports say the Trump administration is considering adopting CENTCOM’s limited‑attack plan to prevent Iran from rebuilding radar and missile capabilities that could be used against ships in the strait.

U.S. forces struck two rocket launchers on Iran’s Larak Island in the Strait of Hormuz on Sunday, an attack that reportedly killed three people. Washington said Tehran had been preparing rockets loaded with naval mines for launch into the strait, and Iran later retaliated on Monday by attacking two U.S. bases in Jordan.

President Donald Trump warned that the United States will “hit Iran hard” and will respond to any attacks on U.S. bases. Analysts, however, note that the U.S. limited its strikes to specific launchers and did not expand to broader Iranian military facilities, indicating that Washington’s current aim is to punish particular actions and maintain the blockade rather than restart a full‑scale war.

Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian said that if Washington is willing to resume the interim agreement signed in June, Tehran will immediately take reciprocal measures. Neither side has signaled an intention to resume a full‑scale war, but both have indicated they will respond to further attacks.

The heightened Middle‑East tension lifted Brent crude futures 3.8% to $93.89 a barrel and WTI up 3.7% to $89.41, the highest since July 24. The conflict, now in its seventh month, is disrupting global energy supplies and continuing to impact financial markets.
Updates will continue...

items.title: 4.5兆美元蘋果帝國換主人！特納斯接棒先闖三大難關
items.title_en: Apple's $4.5 Trillion Empire Gets a New Leader! Ternus Takes the Helm and Faces Three Major Challenges
paras: 蘋果(AAPL-US)周二(1日)正式進入特納斯(John Ternus)時代。這位在蘋果服務25年的硬體老將接替庫克(Tim Cook)出任執行長，成為賈伯斯(Steve Jobs)2011年卸任後，第二位執掌蘋果的執行長，接下市值逾4.5兆美元的科技帝國。
然而，特納斯一上任就得面對三大難關：追趕人工智慧(AI)競賽、因應記憶體短缺與產品漲價壓力，以及降低對中國供應鏈的依賴。隨著科技業者積極開發智慧眼鏡等新型裝置，他還必須證明蘋果能在iPhone之外找到下一個成長引擎。

庫克15年打造4.5兆美元帝國 轉任執行董事長

庫克2011年接棒時，沒有試圖複製賈伯斯的產品願景，而是發揮自身供應鏈及營運專長，將蘋果產品推向全球大眾市場。15年間，蘋果市值由約3,500億美元躍升至逾4.5兆美元，年度營收也從1,080億美元增至上一會計年度的4,160億美元，獲利成長逾4倍至1,120億美元。
庫克也將全球約25億支iPhone形成的龐大使用者基礎，轉化為持續貢獻收入的服務生態系。近年蘋果服務業務成長速度已超越硬體，包括Apple TV、Apple Music、iCloud及訂閱組合Apple One，均成為重要收入來源。
Apple Watch及AirPods等庫克任內推出的產品，也讓穿戴裝置業務在2025會計年度創造350億美元營收。然而，蘋果在庫克時代並未再推出一款足以顛覆產業的產品，售價3,499美元的Vision Pro銷售欠佳，歷時約10年的電動車計畫也在2024年遭到取消。
庫克卸任執行長後不會離開蘋果，而是轉任執行董事長，持續協助處理與全球政策制定者的關係。在美中關係緊張之際，這項安排可讓特納斯借重庫克的政治及供應鏈經驗，但他也必須向投資人、員工和消費者證明，自己並非只是延續前任路線。

記憶體荒逼蘋果漲價 摺疊iPhone恐上看2,500美元

特納斯上任後首次面對全球目光，將是蘋果美西時間9月9日、台灣時間9月10日舉行的秋季發表會，市場預期新一代iPhone、Apple Watch及首款摺疊iPhone將在會中亮相。
AI晶片及伺服器需求暴增，導致全球記憶體及其他零組件供應吃緊。蘋果6月已調高MacBook及iPad售價，目前尚未調漲iPhone，但多名分析師預期，相關宣布可能在特納斯上任初期出現。部分分析師估計，蘋果首款摺疊手機售價可能高達2,500美元。
這場記憶體危機短期內沒有明顯緩解跡象，意味消費性電子產品價格可能長期維持高檔，並永久改變市場需求及競爭格局。
蘋果股價今年以來上漲約17%，表現優於多數大型科技同業，主要受惠於強勁的換機周期，以及Android競爭對手較難承受記憶體短缺。不過，KeyBanc分析師Brandon Nispel警告，若成長主要來自漲價，而非裝置銷量增加，投資人不會願意持續給予高估值，因為這種成長無法長久維持。
特納斯過去曾表示，只要蘋果運用正確的晶片、零組件及其他技術打造出好產品，消費者自然會喜愛。如今他不僅要負責硬體，也得掌管軟體、財務及法務，並在控制成本與維持銷量之間取得平衡。

AI競賽落後 特納斯得找出iPhone之後的答案

生成式AI熱潮正改變消費性裝置市場。OpenAI與SpaceX探索新型運算設備，Meta(META-US)及Google母公司Alphabet(GOOGL-US)則加速發展智慧眼鏡，使智慧型手機未來是否仍能維持核心地位面臨疑問。
蘋果產品在AI功能上落後競爭對手，Siri改版也多次延遲。Zacks Investment Management首席市場策略師Brian Mulberry表示，AI是特納斯面臨的最大挑戰，蘋果必須證明AI不只是iPhone裡的一款應用程式，也不只是Siri。
蘋果據報正開發智慧家庭裝置、機器人，以及配備AI相機的AirPods等新產品。Deepwater Asset Management管理合夥人Gene Munster認為，蘋果選擇一名產品及硬體背景出身的執行長相當重要，特納斯未來數年必須加強招募頂尖工程人才，推動公司重新發明自己。
供應鏈重組同樣是棘手任務。蘋果長期依靠中國製造取得效率優勢，但美中緊張、關稅及供應鏈中斷已暴露生產過度集中的風險。蘋果正擴大印度及越南產能，計劃在2026年底前將多數供應美國市場的iPhone移至印度生產，部分AirPods及iPad則轉往越南組裝。
特納斯接掌的蘋果比15年前規模更大、獲利更多，品牌忠誠度也更強，但同時必須追趕AI浪潮、降低中國依賴，並找出下一款足以接棒iPhone的產品。能否在延續庫克留下的商業帝國之餘，建立自己的產品願景，將決定蘋果下一個時代的方向。
paras_en: Apple (AAPL-US) officially entered the John Ternus era on Tuesday (the 1st). The hardware veteran who has been with Apple for 25 years succeeds Tim Cook as CEO, becoming the second chief executive to run the tech empire worth more than $4.5 trillion since Steve Jobs stepped down in 2011.

However, Ternus must confront three major challenges from day one: catching up in the artificial‑intelligence (AI) race, dealing with memory‑chip shortages and pricing pressure on products, and reducing reliance on the Chinese supply chain. As tech firms push new devices such as smart glasses, he also has to prove Apple can find a growth engine beyond the iPhone.

Cook built a $4.5 trillion empire over 15 years and will become executive chairman. When Cook took over in 2011, he did not try to replicate Jobs’s product vision but leveraged his supply‑chain and operational expertise to push Apple products into the global mass market. Over 15 years, Apple’s market cap rose from about $350 billion to over $4.5 trillion, annual revenue grew from $108 billion to $416 billion in the last fiscal year, and profit more than quadrupled to $112 billion.

Cook also turned the massive user base of roughly 2.5 billion iPhones into a recurring‑revenue services ecosystem. In recent years Apple’s services growth has outpaced hardware, with Apple TV, Apple Music, iCloud and the subscription bundle Apple One becoming important revenue streams.

Products launched under Cook such as the Apple Watch and AirPods helped the wearables business generate $35 billion in revenue in fiscal 2025. Yet Apple did not introduce a truly industry‑disrupting product in the Cook era; the $3,499 Vision Pro sold poorly, and the electric‑car project that had been ten years in the making was cancelled in 2024.

After stepping down as CEO, Cook will remain at Apple as executive chairman, continuing to handle relations with global policymakers. At a time of tense U.S.–China ties, this arrangement lets Ternus draw on Cook’s political and supply‑chain experience, but he must also prove to investors, employees and consumers that he is not merely a caretaker of the status quo.

The first global spotlight Ternus will face after taking the helm is Apple’s autumn event on September 9 Pacific Time (September 10 Taiwan time). The market expects a new generation iPhone, a new Apple Watch and the first foldable iPhone to be unveiled at the show.

AI chips and server demand have surged, tightening global supplies of memory and other components. Apple raised the prices of its MacBook and iPad lines in June and has not yet adjusted iPhone pricing, but several analysts expect price announcements could come early in Ternus’s tenure. Some estimate the first foldable iPhone could cost as much as $2,500.

The memory shortage shows no sign of easing in the short term, meaning consumer‑electronics prices may stay premium for the foreseeable future, permanently reshaping market demand and competitive dynamics.

Apple’s stock has risen about 17% year‑to‑date, outperforming most large‑cap peers, driven mainly by a strong upgrade cycle and the fact Android rivals are feeling the pinch of memory scarcity more acutely. However, KeyBanc analyst Brandon Nispel warned that if growth comes mainly from price hikes rather than higher device sales, investors will be reluctant to sustain lofty valuations because such growth is not sustainable.

Ternus has previously said that as long as Apple uses the right chips, components and technology to build great products, consumers will naturally love them. Now he must oversee hardware, software, finance and legal, balancing cost control with maintaining sales volume.

The AI race has left Apple trailing, and Ternus must find the post‑iPhone answer. The generative‑AI boom is reshaping the consumer‑device market. OpenAI and SpaceX are exploring new computing hardware, while Meta (META‑US) and Alphabet (GOOGL‑US) are accelerating smart‑glasses development, casting doubt on whether smartphones will remain the core platform.

Apple’s AI capabilities lag behind rivals, and Siri’s updates have been repeatedly delayed. Zacks Investment Management’s chief market strategist Brian Mulberry said AI is the biggest challenge facing Ternus; Apple must prove AI is more than an app inside the iPhone or just Siri.

Apple is reportedly developing smart‑home devices, robots, and AirPods equipped with AI‑powered cameras. Deepwater Asset Management partner Gene Munster believes it is crucial that Apple chose a CEO with a product‑hardware background; Ternus will need to ramp up hiring top engineering talent over the next few years to reinvent the company.

Supply‑chain restructuring is another thorny issue. Apple has long relied on Chinese manufacturing for efficiency, but U.S.–China tensions, tariffs and supply‑chain disruptions have exposed the risk of over‑concentration. Apple is expanding capacity in India and Vietnam, planning to shift most iPhone production for the U.S. market to India by the end of 2026, with some AirPods and iPad assembly moving to Vietnam.

Apple under Ternus will be larger, more profitable and have stronger brand loyalty than it was 15 years ago, but it must catch up with the AI wave, reduce dependence on China, and find the next product that can succeed the iPhone. Whether he can build his own product vision while extending the commercial empire left by Cook will determine the direction of Apple’s next era.

items.title: 荷姆茲海峽石油突圍術曝光！船對船接力運油 亞洲買家願付溢價
items.title_en: Houmouz Strait Oil Breakthrough Exposed! Ship-to-Ship Relay Transport, Asian Buyers Willing to Pay Premium
paras: 中東產油國正透過更多方式將原油送往市場，並設法規避伊朗的攻擊與威脅，盼能穩定油價，拜此之賜，荷姆茲海峽近期原油運輸量逐步回升。
中東產油國運用的主要策略，是增加「船對船轉運」。這種宛如接力賽的運輸方式最近幾天明顯加快，大型油輪設法在穿越荷姆茲海峽時避開伊朗帶來的風險，以維持全球原油供應。
在這種模式下，兩艘油輪等於接力合作，把原油從波斯灣運出。
中東國營石油公司的接駁油輪，會把原油從波斯灣穿越荷姆茲海峽，運往阿曼灣。雖然這是整段航程中風險最高的部分，但國營石油公司比過去更願意自行承擔風險，因為不願親自穿越荷姆茲海峽的客戶，願意支付額外溢價。
當油輪抵達海峽另一側的阿曼灣後，來自亞洲煉油商等買家的油輪已在當地等候，接手後再駛往最終目的地。
大宗商品數據分析公司Kpler分析師Matt Smith說：「賣方承擔(穿越海峽的)風險，而買方願意以溢價購買這些原油。」
Kpler近期將「船對船轉運」納入石油流量估算後，上修了對波斯灣原油外運量的未確認預估值，8月中旬高達每日1500萬桶。
高盛分析師近期在報告中表示，他們以不同方法結合Kpler數據、其他資料來源及自行計算後，對波斯灣每日石油與石油產品出口量的預估值約1500-1600萬桶。
高盛指出，這雖然仍比戰前水準低約每日700-800萬桶，但較3月低點增加了每日500-600萬桶。
高盛分析師表示，船對船轉運增加，加上持續有船舶以關閉類似GPS定位訊號避免遭追蹤的方式通過海峽，顯示產油商與航運業者不僅正在適應中東衝突，也已把「干擾可能持續至2027年很長一段時間」納入考量。
美國能源部長萊特(Chris Wright)上周在X平台表示，美軍協助超過1500萬桶石油與石油產品通過荷姆茲海峽，若加上管線運輸，該地區每日離境的石油與石油產品總量接近2000萬桶。
萊特還透露，過去七天經由荷姆茲海峽運出的石油平均每日超過800萬桶。他說：「毫無疑問，在美國海軍協助下，石油正持續通過荷姆茲海峽。」
美國官員上周向Axios表示，伊朗已失去對荷姆茲海峽大部分的控制力，美軍目前實際上已控制該海峽大部分區域。
自2月底戰爭爆發以來，華爾街分析師一直難以掌握波斯灣石油出口量最關鍵的數據，能協助更精確追蹤船舶的衛星影像，往往存在延遲或無法取得。

船對船轉運與「暗船」航行

船對船轉運並不需要特殊工程技術，這種方式在全球能源運輸業早已相當普遍。
Kpler的Smith表示，目前有「數十艘」空載的超大型原油運輸船(VLCC)正在阿曼灣等待裝載原油，但他拒絕提供具體數字。這些接駁油輪選擇靠近阿曼一側穿越海峽，推測可獲得美國海軍某種程度的保護。
Smith說：「我們看到所有VLCC都停留在阿曼灣，然後再陸續出發。」
Smith表示，「暗船」航行、衛星影像延遲及其他追蹤荷姆茲海峽石油流量的困難，也使近期數據可能獲得進一步上修。
此外，中東石油公司也透過管線增加將原油運往紅海的數量，進一步提高整體出口量。
他說：「儘管如此，荷姆茲海峽的運輸量仍然低迷，遠低於衝突爆發前水準。目前各類石油液體每日通過量約800萬桶，遠低於戰前約每日2100萬桶。」
由於荷姆茲海峽周邊戰火在周末升溫，油價應聲走高，西德州原油(WTI)與布蘭特原油期貨周一(31日)雙雙上漲近3%。回顧整個8月，WTI原油期貨約漲1.4%，而對地緣政治動盪通常反應更為劇烈的布蘭特原油期貨則約漲3%。
能源市場目前主要依靠兩種方式，來彌補荷姆茲海峽原油流量未能完全恢復的缺口：一是需求遭到抑制，尤其是原本為中東原油與石油產品最大進口方的亞洲國家，二是改從其他國家採購原油，包括美國。
不過，目前嚴重的瓶頸已轉移至煉油環節，煉油業者生產汽油、燃料油與柴油所要求的利潤率，近幾周已攀升至歷史新高。美國則把油價下跌的一部分希望，寄託在與委內瑞拉達成的石油協議上。
paras_en: Middle Eastern oil producers are using more methods to ship crude to the market and are trying to avoid Iranian attacks and threats, hoping to stabilize oil prices. As a result, oil transport through the Houmouz Strait has gradually increased recently.

The main strategy employed by Middle Eastern producers is to increase "ship-to-ship transfer." This relay‑style transport, which resembles a relay race, has noticeably accelerated in recent days as large tankers try to avoid the risks posed by Iran while crossing the Houmouz Strait to maintain global crude supply.
In this model, two tankers work together like a relay, moving crude from the Persian Gulf.

State‑owned oil companies’ shuttle tankers carry crude from the Persian Gulf across the Houmouz Strait to the Gulf of Oman. Although this is the riskiest part of the entire journey, state‑owned companies are now more willing to bear the risk themselves, because customers who do not want to cross the Houmouz Strait directly are willing to pay an extra premium.

When the tanker arrives on the other side of the strait in the Gulf of Oman, tankers from Asian refineries and other buyers are already waiting locally to take over and then head to the final destination.
Commodity data firm Kpler analyst Matt Smith said: "The sellers bear the risk of crossing the strait, while buyers are willing to pay a premium for this crude."

After incorporating "ship-to-ship transfer" into its oil flow estimates, Kpler recently raised its unconfirmed estimate of crude exports from the Persian Gulf, reaching up to 15 million barrels per day in mid‑August.

Goldman Sachs analysts recently reported that, after combining Kpler data, other sources, and their own calculations, their estimate of daily crude and petroleum product exports from the Persian Gulf is about 15–16 million barrels.
Goldman Sachs noted that, although this is still about 7–8 million barrels per day below pre‑war levels, it is 5–6 million barrels per day higher than the March low.

Goldman Sachs analysts said that the increase in ship‑to‑ship transfer, combined with ships continuing to use GPS‑jamming techniques to avoid tracking, shows that producers and shipping companies are not only adapting to the Middle East conflict but also factoring in that "interference could continue for a long time until 2027."

U.S. Energy Secretary Chris Wright posted on X last week that the U.S. military helped more than 15 million barrels of crude and petroleum products pass through the Houmouz Strait; adding pipeline transport, the total daily outbound volume from the region is close to 20 million barrels.

Wright also revealed that, in the past seven days, the average daily crude shipped through the Houmouz Strait exceeded 8 million barrels. He said, "Without a doubt, with U.S. Navy assistance, oil continues to flow through the Houmouz Strait."
U.S. officials told Axios last week that Iran has lost control over most of the Houmouz Strait, and the U.S. military now effectively controls the majority of the area.

Since the war began at the end of February, Wall Street analysts have struggled to grasp the most critical data on Persian Gulf crude exports, and satellite imagery that could help track ships more precisely is often delayed or unavailable.

Ship‑to‑ship transfer and "dark ships" navigation
Ship‑to‑ship transfer does not require special engineering; this method has long been common in the global energy transport industry.

Kpler’s Smith said that there are currently "dozens" of empty ultra‑large crude carriers (VLCCs) waiting to be loaded in the Gulf of Oman, but he declined to give specific numbers. These shuttle tankers choose to cross the strait near the Oman side, presumably to receive some protection from the U.S. Navy.
Smith said, "We see all VLCCs parked in the Gulf of Oman, then gradually depart."
Smith added that "dark ship" navigation, satellite image delays, and other difficulties in tracking crude flow through the Houmouz Strait may lead to further upward revisions of recent data.
In addition, Middle Eastern oil companies are increasing the amount of crude shipped to the Red Sea via pipelines, further boosting overall export volume.

He said, "Nevertheless, transport through the Houmouz Strait remains sluggish, far below pre‑conflict levels. Daily throughput of all petroleum liquids is about 8 million barrels, far below the pre‑war figure of about 21 million barrels per day."

Because fighting around the Houmouz Strait intensified over the weekend, oil prices rose accordingly, with WTI and Brent crude futures both up nearly 3% on Monday (31st). Over the entire month of August, WTI futures rose about 1.4%, while Brent futures, which typically react more sharply to geopolitical turmoil, rose about 3%.

The energy market currently relies on two main ways to fill the gap left by the incomplete recovery of crude flow through the Houmouz Strait: first, demand is suppressed, especially in Asian countries that were the largest importers of Middle Eastern crude and petroleum products; second, sourcing crude from other countries, including the United States.

However, the current severe bottleneck has shifted to the refining stage, as the profit margins required by refineries to produce gasoline, fuel oil, and diesel have risen to historic highs in recent weeks. The United States is hoping to offset some of the oil price decline by its oil agreement with Venezuela.

items.title: Fed可以專心對付通膨了？美國7月職缺增至727萬個 就業市場持穩
items.title_en: Can the Fed Focus on Inflation Now? U.S. Job Openings Rise to 7.27 Million in July, Employment Market Remains Steady
paras: 美國7月職缺數小幅增加、裁員人數下降，但企業招聘明顯減少，顯示勞動市場仍處於「低招聘、低解雇」的僵持狀態。就業市場保持穩定，可能讓聯準會(Fed)持續將政策重心放在居高不下的通膨。
美國勞工統計局(BLS)周二(1日)公布，7月職缺暨勞工流動調查(JOLTS)顯示，截至月底職缺數增加8.9萬個至727.1萬個，低於市場預期的730萬至731萬個。6月數據則由原先公布的735.9萬個大幅下修至718.2萬個。
7月職缺率由6月的4.3%升至4.4%，主要由製造業、非教育類州及地方政府，以及醫療保健與社會救助產業帶動。其中製造業職缺增加7.9萬個，幾乎全部來自耐久財產業，整體製造業職缺創2023年12月以來最高；休閒及旅宿業職缺則降至2021年來最低。
不過，企業招聘人數減少27.8萬人至505.4萬人，招聘率也從3.4%降至3.2%。專業及商業服務業招聘人數大減18.8萬人，是整體降幅的主要來源，顯示企業在地緣政治不確定性及通膨持續的情況下，對擴大人力仍相當謹慎。
裁員及解雇人數則減少11.9萬人至166.6萬人，創1月以來最低，裁員率由1.1%降至1%。製造業解雇人數更降至逾5年最低。主動離職率也小幅降至1.9%，反映勞工轉職意願偏弱。
儘管Visa(V-US)、Uber(UBER-US)及微軟(MSFT-US)近期相繼宣布裁員，美國初領失業救濟金人數仍維持低檔，尚未出現大規模解雇。7月每名失業者約有1.1個職缺，遠低於2022年高峰時的2個，但供需仍大致平衡。
部分經濟學家提醒，JOLTS調查回覆率已由新冠疫情前約58%降至略高於30%，不宜過度依賴單月數據判斷勞動市場健康狀況。
Fed主席華許(Kevin Warsh)日前形容勞動市場「相當穩定」且符合充分就業。芝商所FedWatch工具顯示，市場預估Fed在9月15日至16日會議升息1碼的機率約為66%。投資人將關注周五公布的非農就業報告，市場預估8月新增5.5萬個工作機會，扭轉7月減少2.3萬人的局面。
paras_en: The U.S. saw a modest rise in job openings and a decline in layoffs in July, yet corporate hiring fell sharply, indicating the labor market remains in a stalemate of "low hiring, low firing." The employment market stays steady, which may allow the Federal Reserve to keep its focus on persistently high inflation.

The U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) released the July Job Openings and Labor Turnover Survey (JOLTS) on Tuesday (Jan. 1), showing that by month‑end job openings increased by 89,000 to 7.271 million, below market expectations of 7.30–7.31 million. June data were revised down from the originally reported 7.359 million to 7.182 million.

July job openings rose from 4.3% in June to 4.4%, driven mainly by manufacturing, non‑education state and local governments, and healthcare and social assistance. Manufacturing openings grew by 79,000, almost all from durable goods, marking the highest level since December 2023; leisure and hospitality openings fell to a 2021 low.

However, corporate hiring fell by 278,000 to 5.054 million, and the hiring rate dropped from 3.4% to 3.2%. Professional and business services hiring fell by 188,000, the largest share of the overall decline, showing firms remain cautious about expanding staff amid geopolitical uncertainty and ongoing inflation.

Layoffs and separations fell by 119,000 to 1.666 million, the lowest since January, with the layoff rate dropping from 1.1% to 1%. Manufacturing separations fell to a more than five‑year low. Voluntary resignation rates also fell slightly to 1.9%, reflecting weak labor‑switching willingness.

Despite recent layoffs announced by Visa (V-US), Uber (UBER-US), and Microsoft (MSFT-US), the number of initial unemployment claims remains low, with no large‑scale layoffs evident. In July, each unemployed person had about 1.1 job openings, far below the 2 openings per unemployed at the 2022 peak, yet supply and demand remain roughly balanced.
Some economists warn that JOLTS response rates have fallen from about 58% pre‑COVID to just over 30% now, so single‑month data should not be over‑interpreted to gauge labor‑market health.

Fed Chair Kevin Warsh recently described the labor market as "quite stable" and consistent with full employment. The CME FedWatch tool shows a 66% probability that the Fed will raise rates by one basis point at the September 15–16 meeting. Investors will focus on Friday's non‑farm payroll report, which is expected to show 55,000 new jobs in August, reversing July's decline of 23,000.

items.title: 〈車市〉8月銷量跌破3萬台創近半年低 Q4漸入佳境
items.title_en: Car Market: August Sales Fall Below 30,000 Units, Reaching Lowest in Nearly Half a Year; Q4 Improving
paras: 8月台灣新車掛牌統計今(1)日出爐，總銷量跌破3萬台整數關卡至29222台，月減24.4%，年減0.8%，創3月以來單月低，主要反映農曆7月的影響，隨著各大車商的新車款陸續上市、關稅議題逐漸式微，加上台股反彈推升消費動能，車商認為，車市買氣有望逐月回升。
車市龍頭和泰車(2207-TW)認為，在國內經濟強勁成長下，市場買氣逐步回籠， 9 月新車掛牌總規模有望回升至34000 台。
8月銷售數據中，前10大品牌中和泰車包辦前2名，分別為TOYOTA 8479台，年減8.8%，LEXUS 2091台，年減20%，但市占率合計達36.2%，買氣相對平穩；TESLA、HONDA和BMW、BENZ分別居3-6名，銷量分別為1737台、1500台、1281台和1270台。
而累計前8月總車市銷量270156台，仍維持年增2.4%，前10大車商中繳出成長成績的有TOYOTA 83597台，年增2.4%，HONDA 15517台，年增19.8%，TESLA 13334台，年增66.7%，MITSUBISHI 11093台，年增27%，FORD 10349台，年增30.3%。
隨著第四季車市傳統旺季到來，各大車商正緊鑼密鼓推出新車，台灣賓士表示，全新 Mercedes-Benz S-Class 將於9 月 11 日登台。
而裕日車(2227-TW)也宣布，日本原裝進口NISSAN X-TRAIL e-POWER 啟動預售，以新世代日式美學迎來設計進化，同時延續e-POWER、VC-TURBO和e-4ORCE核心電驅科技。
汎德永業(2247-TW)則指出，BMW全新純電新車iX3市場反應熱烈，自開放接單以來收單暢旺，預計第四季起陸續到港交車。
paras_en: August Taiwan new‑car registration statistics were released today, showing total sales falling below the 30,000‑unit threshold at 29,222 units, a 24.4% month‑over‑month decline and a 0.8% year‑over‑year drop, the lowest monthly figure since March. This reflects the impact of the lunar July holiday; as new models from major manufacturers roll out, tariff issues ease, and the Taiwanese stock market rebound boosts consumer momentum, dealers expect monthly sales to recover.

The market leader, Hwa Tai Motors (2207‑TW), believes that with strong domestic economic growth, buying momentum will gradually rebound, and new‑car registrations in September could rise to 34,000 units.

In August sales data, Hwa Tai Motors topped the top ten brands, taking first and second places with TOYOTA at 8,479 units (down 8.8% year‑over‑year) and LEXUS at 2,091 units (down 20%). Together they captured 36.2% of the market share, indicating relatively stable demand. TESLA, HONDA, BMW, and BENZ occupied positions three to six with sales of 1,737, 1,500, 1,281, and 1,270 units respectively.

Cumulative sales through August reached 270,156 units, maintaining a 2.4% year‑over‑year increase. Among the top ten manufacturers, TOYOTA delivered 83,597 units (up 2.4% year‑over‑year), HONDA 15,517 units (up 19.8%), TESLA 13,334 units (up 66.7%), MITSUBISHI 11,093 units (up 27%), and FORD 10,349 units (up 30.3%).
With the traditional Q4 peak season approaching, major manufacturers are launching new models. Taiwan Mercedes‑Benz announced that the all‑new Mercedes‑Benz S‑Class will debut on September 11.

Yurich Motors (2227‑TW) also announced that the Japan‑made, imported NISSAN X‑TRAIL e‑POWER will begin pre‑sales, bringing a new generation of Japanese aesthetics and continuing the core e‑POWER, VC‑TURBO, and e‑4ORCE electric‑drive technologies.

Pan‑Deng Yong‑Ying (2247‑TW) noted that BMW’s all‑electric iX3 has received a strong market response; since opening orders, sales have been brisk, and deliveries are expected to begin in the fourth quarter.

items.title: Fed升息壓力又來了！美國製造業連8月擴張 新訂單放緩、成本仍高
items.title_en: Fed Rate‑Hike Pressure Returns! U.S. Manufacturing Expands for 8th Month in August, New Orders Slow, Costs Remain High
paras: 美國8月製造業連續第8個月擴張，成長速度雖從近4年高點略為放緩，整體動能仍保持穩健。不過，新訂單降溫、原物料價格居高不下及供應鏈延誤，顯示中東戰爭與關稅造成的成本壓力尚未消退。
美國供應管理協會(ISM)周二(9/1)公布，8月製造業指數由7月的55.6降至54.6，低於市場預期的55.2，但仍是2022年以來第二高。指數高於50代表製造業處於擴張。

美國 8 月 ISM 製造業指數細項：(50 為榮枯線)


新訂單指數報53.7，前值56.7
生產指數報58.3，前值58.5
僱傭指數報58.3，前值52.8
供應商交貨指數報59.3，前值58.9
存貨指數報50.6，前值51.2
客戶端存貨指數報42.8，前值40.7
價格指數報71.1，前值71.1
未完成訂單指數報51.8，前值55.0
出口訂單指數報53.2，前值53.0
原物料進口指數報52.5，前值55.7




標普全球公布的8月美國製造業採購經理人指數(PMI)則持平於53.9，高於初值53.2及市場預期的53.4，同樣顯示製造業營運狀況持續改善。

新訂單成長放緩 企業提前拉貨效應消退

ISM生產指數寫下2021年底以來第二高，但反映需求的新訂單指數由7月的56.7降至53.7，創3月以來最低，未完成訂單也同步減少，出口訂單則小幅增加。
部分降溫可能反映企業為躲避漲價及短缺而提前下單的效應逐漸消退。美國與以色列對伊朗的戰爭已持續6個月，中東衝突加劇原有的關稅、能源及供應鏈壓力，使企業對後續價格上漲和原料短缺更加擔憂。
標普全球經濟學家Usamah Bhatti表示，美國製造業持續成長值得肯定，但8月數據也暴露出部分裂痕。第二季至8月的資料顯示，企業累積庫存是支撐生產及需求的重要因素，但8月產出與新訂單成長均已放緩。
製造業約占美國經濟的9.4%，今年以來逐漸擺脫持續數年的低迷，主要受惠於消費需求保持韌性、企業投資穩健、政府增加國防支出，以及人工智慧(AI)基礎建設熱潮。企業庫存已連續5季下降，創金融海嘯以來最長紀錄，後續補庫存也有望為製造業帶來額外支撐。
8月共有15個製造產業回報成長，包括基本金屬、電氣設備及家電，木製品與化學產品則陷入萎縮。

成本壓力仍高 Fed 9月升息機率逼近七成

需求放緩仍未緩解供應鏈壓力。ISM供應商交貨指數由58.9升至59.3，高於50代表交貨速度進一步放慢；原物料支付價格指數則維持在71.1，雖是2月以來最低，仍處於高檔，顯示工廠端通膨短期內難以明顯降溫。
兩份調查對就業的描述並不一致。ISM工廠就業指數由7月的52.8降至51.2，顯示增聘速度放慢；標普全球調查則顯示，製造商以今年最快速度增加人力，企業對未來一年產出的信心也升至3個月高點，部分反映市場期待戰爭落幕及美國政策趨於穩定。
市場正等待周五公布的美國非農就業報告。經濟學家預估，8月製造業就業仍然疲弱，但整體非農就業人數可望在7月意外減少後反彈。
聯準會(Fed)主席華許(Kevin Warsh)上周五表示，若官員無法確信通膨正朝2%目標下降，Fed仍有工作要做。芝商所FedWatch工具顯示，市場預估Fed在9月15日至16日會議升息1碼的機率約為70%。
paras_en: The U.S. manufacturing sector expanded for the eighth consecutive month in August, with growth slowing slightly from its near‑four‑year high but still maintaining robust momentum. However, new orders cooled, raw‑material prices remain high, and supply‑chain delays indicate that cost pressures from the Middle‑East war and tariffs have not abated.

On Tuesday (9/1), the Institute for Supply Management (ISM) released its August manufacturing index, which fell from 55.6 in July to 54.6, below the market expectation of 55.2 but still the second‑highest since 2022. An index above 50 signals expansion in manufacturing.

The August ISM manufacturing index components (50 is the line of activity):
New orders index 53.7 (previous 56.7)
Production index 58.3 (previous 58.5)
Employment index 58.3 (previous 52.8)
Supplier delivery index 59.3 (previous 58.9)
Inventories index 50.6 (previous 51.2)
Customer‑end inventories index 42.8 (previous 40.7)
Price index 71.1 (previous 71.1)
Unfinished‑orders index 51.8 (previous 55.0)
Export orders index 53.2 (previous 53.0)
Raw‑material imports index 52.5 (previous 55.7)

The S&P Global August U.S. Manufacturing Purchasing Managers’ Index (PMI) held steady at 53.9, above the initial reading of 53.2 and the market expectation of 53.4, again indicating continued improvement in manufacturing operations.

New orders growth slowed as the early‑ordering effect faded. The ISM production index recorded its second‑highest level since the end of 2021, but the demand‑driven new‑orders index fell from 56.7 in July to 53.7, the lowest since March, with unfinished orders also declining while export orders edged up.

The cooling may reflect the waning of firms’ early ordering to avoid price hikes and shortages. The U.S.–Israel war over Iran has persisted for six months, intensifying existing tariff, energy, and supply‑chain pressures and heightening concerns about future price increases and raw‑material shortages.

S&P Global economist Usamah Bhatti noted that U.S. manufacturing growth remains commendable, yet August data reveal fractures. From Q2 to August, accumulated inventories have supported production and demand, but output and new‑orders growth have slowed.

Manufacturing accounts for about 9.4% of the U.S. economy and has gradually shed a multi‑year slump, largely thanks to resilient consumer demand, steady corporate investment, increased defense spending, and the AI infrastructure boom. Firm inventories have fallen for five consecutive quarters, the longest streak since the financial crisis, and replenishment is expected to further support the sector.
In August, 15 manufacturing subsectors reported growth, including basic metals, electrical equipment, and home appliances, while wood products and chemicals contracted.

Cost pressures remain high as the Fed’s September rate‑hike probability approaches 70%. Demand easing has not relieved supply‑chain strain. The ISM supplier delivery index rose from 58.9 to 59.3, indicating slower delivery speeds; the raw‑material price index stayed at 71.1, its lowest since February but still high, showing that factory‑side inflation will not ease markedly in the near term.

Employment figures from the two surveys diverge. The ISM plant‑employment index fell from 52.8 in July to 51.2, signaling a slowdown in hiring; the S&P Global survey shows manufacturers adding staff at the fastest pace this year, with confidence in next‑year output rising to a three‑month high, partly reflecting expectations that the war will end and U.S. policy will stabilize.

The market is awaiting Friday’s release of the U.S. non‑farm payroll report. Economists predict that August manufacturing employment will remain weak, but overall non‑farm employment could rebound after the unexpected July decline.

Federal Reserve Chair Kevin Warsh said last Friday that if officials cannot be confident that inflation is moving toward the 2% target, the Fed still has work to do. The CME FedWatch tool shows a roughly 70% probability that the Fed will raise rates by one basis point at the September 15‑16 meeting.

items.title: Fed又一官員放鷹！巴爾：通膨不降就果斷升息
items.title_en: Fed Official Takes Hawkish Stance Again: Barr Says Inflation Must Drop Before Cutting Rates
paras: 聯準會(Fed)理事巴爾(Michael Barr)周二(9/1)表示，若通膨未能充分降溫，他將支持果斷升息，並警告物價漲勢持續高於目標逾5年，可能使更廣泛的通膨壓力逐漸根深柢固。
巴爾在華盛頓一場銀行業論壇的預備講稿中表示，如果未來數據能讓他相信，通膨正朝2%目標放緩，Fed可以花更多時間評估政策立場；但若通膨降溫幅度不足，官員就應果斷升息。
身為Fed理事，巴爾是聯邦公開市場委員會(FOMC)的永久投票委員。他支持Fed在7月會議將基準利率維持於3.5%至3.75%，但這次談話顯示，他的立場可能隨通膨數據轉向。
巴爾指出，美國消費支出迄今大致維持韌性，整體經濟表現仍然良好，但通膨依舊過高。最新數據顯示，整體物價年增3.7%，排除食品及能源的核心通膨率則為3.3%，雙雙高於Fed的2%目標。
伊朗戰爭推升油價、美國新一輪關稅，以及人工智慧(AI)資料中心建設帶動需求激增，都使通膨壓力更加持久。中東局勢再度引發疑慮之際，美國10年期公債殖利率周二也升至2025年1月中旬以來最高。
Fed內部對下一步政策已出現分歧。7月會議中，明尼亞波利斯聯準銀行總裁卡什卡里(Neel Kashkari)、克里夫蘭聯準銀行總裁哈瑪克(Beth Hammack)及達拉斯聯準銀行總裁蘿根(Lorie Logan)，均持異議並主張升息。
Fed主席華許(Kevin Warsh)上周在傑克森霍爾全球央行年會警告，通膨並未明顯降溫，若物價壓力短期內未緩解，Fed就必須採取行動。相關談話被市場廣泛解讀為偏向升息。
芝商所(CME Group)FedWatch工具顯示，交易員周二預估Fed本月升息的機率約為66%。Fed將於9月11日取得最新消費者物價指數(CPI)，並於9月15日至16日召開利率決策會議，這份通膨報告將成為是否升息的關鍵依據。
paras_en: Federal Reserve Governor Michael Barr said on Tuesday (9/1) that if inflation fails to cool sufficiently, he will support decisive rate hikes and warned that price pressures remaining above target for over five years could entrench broader inflationary pressures.

In a prepared speech at a Washington banking forum, Barr noted that if future data convinces him that inflation is easing toward the 2% goal, the Fed could afford more time to assess policy; but if the cooling is inadequate, officials should act decisively to raise rates.

As a Fed governor, Barr is a permanent voting member of the FOMC. He supported keeping the policy rate at 3.5%–3.75% at the July meeting, but this talk suggests his stance could shift with inflation data.

Barr pointed out that U.S. consumer spending has remained largely resilient and the overall economy still performs well, yet inflation remains too high. Recent data show overall prices rose 3.7% YoY, and core inflation excluding food and energy was 3.3%, both above the Fed’s 2% target.

Oil prices spurred by the Iran war, a new round of U.S. tariffs, and a surge in demand from AI data center construction have all made inflationary pressures more persistent. Amid renewed Middle East concerns, the U.S. 10‑year Treasury yield rose on Tuesday to its highest level since mid‑January 2025.

Within the Fed, there is now a split on next steps. At the July meeting, Minneapolis Fed President Neel Kashkari, Cleveland Fed President Beth Hammack, and Dallas Fed President Lorie Logan all dissented and advocated rate hikes.

Fed Chair Kevin Warsh warned last week at the Jackson Hole Global Central Bank Summit that inflation has not clearly cooled, and if price pressures do not ease in the short term, the Fed must act. Market participants broadly interpreted this as hawkish.

CME Group’s FedWatch tool shows traders estimated a 66% chance of a rate hike this month. The Fed will release the latest CPI on September 11 and hold its rate decision meeting on September 15–16; that inflation report will be key to deciding whether to hike.

items.title: 郭明錤：輝達已重啟Rubin CPX計畫 將於明年第一季開始生產
items.title_en: Mark Gurman: Nvidia Resumes Rubin CPX Project, Production to Begin in Q1 Next Year
paras: 知名分析師郭明錤最新發文表示，輝達已重啟先前市場傳聞已從路線圖剔除的Rubin CPX項目，預計明年第一季投產。
相較於先前設計，新版CPX大幅強化預填充(prefill)效能，並對GPU規格與機架架構作出重大改動，凸顯輝達對預填解決方案的高度重視。
規格方面，CPX改用168GB HBM4(原設計為128GB GDDR7，Rubin為288GB)，功耗上限符合Rubin的每顆2300 瓦。機架改採獨立MGX ETL設計，客戶可選64/128/192/256顆GPU配置，每64顆構成一個機架模組，由八個運算托盤(各含8顆CPX)與一個交換托盤組成。
互聯架構上，NVLink(每秒頻寬1–1.5TB)僅用於托盤內縱向擴展，跨托盤橫向擴展由Spectrum-6乙太網路全銅L1鏈路承擔，跨模組則經OSFP光鏈路處理。
運作模式上，CPX必須與Vera Rubin NVL72搭配，建議 1:1配置，CPX還負責預先填充並建構KV緩存，再透過乙太網路RDMA傳輸給Rubin進行解碼。
郭明錤強調，當前逾50%AI推理工作負載來自輸入上下文處理及KV快取構建，每個八顆CPX托盤擁有約1.34TB HBM4，足以涵蓋多數長上下文預填充需求。
他並指出，CPX 的定位正是長上下文場景下單位成本的最佳效能解方，為AI推理基建提供靈活且低成本的預填選項。
paras_en: Renowned analyst Mark Gurman recently posted that Nvidia has restarted the Rubin CPX project, which had previously been removed from the roadmap, with plans to begin production in the first quarter of next year.

Compared to earlier designs, the new CPX significantly boosts prefill performance and introduces major changes to GPU specifications and rack architecture, underscoring Nvidia’s strong focus on prefill solutions.

In terms of specifications, the CPX now uses 168 GB HBM4 (instead of the original 128 GB GDDR7, and Rubin’s 288 GB), with a power limit matching Rubin’s 2,300 W per unit. The rack adopts an independent MGX ETL design, allowing customers to choose 64/128/192/256‑GPU configurations; every 64 GPUs form a rack module, composed of eight compute trays (each holding 8 CPXs) and one exchange tray.

On the interconnect side, NVLink (1–1.5 TB/s bandwidth) is used only for vertical scaling within a tray, while horizontal scaling across trays is handled by Spectrum‑6 Ethernet full‑copper L1 links, and cross‑module scaling uses OSFP optical links.

Operationally, the CPX must be paired with the Vera Rubin NVL72, with a recommended 1:1 configuration. The CPX also handles prefill and builds the KV cache, then transfers it to Rubin for decoding via Ethernet RDMA.

Gurman emphasized that over 50% of AI inference workloads come from input context processing and KV cache construction; each eight‑CPX tray contains about 1.34 TB of HBM4, sufficient to cover most long‑context prefill needs.
He added that the CPX is positioned as the optimal cost‑performance solution for long‑context scenarios, offering a flexible and low‑cost prefill option for AI inference infrastructure.

items.title: 〈車市〉8月銷量跌破3萬台創近半年低 Q4漸入佳境
items.title_en: Car Market: August Sales Fall Below 30,000 Units, Reaching Lowest in Nearly Half a Year; Q4 Improving
paras: 8月台灣新車掛牌統計今(1)日出爐，總銷量跌破3萬台整數關卡至29222台，月減24.4%，年減0.8%，創3月以來單月低，主要反映農曆7月的影響，隨著各大車商的新車款陸續上市、關稅議題逐漸式微，加上台股反彈推升消費動能，車商認為，車市買氣有望逐月回升。
車市龍頭和泰車(2207-TW)認為，在國內經濟強勁成長下，市場買氣逐步回籠， 9 月新車掛牌總規模有望回升至34000 台。
8月銷售數據中，前10大品牌中和泰車包辦前2名，分別為TOYOTA 8479台，年減8.8%，LEXUS 2091台，年減20%，但市占率合計達36.2%，買氣相對平穩；TESLA、HONDA和BMW、BENZ分別居3-6名，銷量分別為1737台、1500台、1281台和1270台。
而累計前8月總車市銷量270156台，仍維持年增2.4%，前10大車商中繳出成長成績的有TOYOTA 83597台，年增2.4%，HONDA 15517台，年增19.8%，TESLA 13334台，年增66.7%，MITSUBISHI 11093台，年增27%，FORD 10349台，年增30.3%。
隨著第四季車市傳統旺季到來，各大車商正緊鑼密鼓推出新車，台灣賓士表示，全新 Mercedes-Benz S-Class 將於9 月 11 日登台。
而裕日車(2227-TW)也宣布，日本原裝進口NISSAN X-TRAIL e-POWER 啟動預售，以新世代日式美學迎來設計進化，同時延續e-POWER、VC-TURBO和e-4ORCE核心電驅科技。
汎德永業(2247-TW)則指出，BMW全新純電新車iX3市場反應熱烈，自開放接單以來收單暢旺，預計第四季起陸續到港交車。
paras_en: August Taiwan new‑car registration statistics were released today, showing total sales falling below the 30,000‑unit threshold at 29,222 units, a 24.4% month‑over‑month decline and a 0.8% year‑over‑year drop, the lowest monthly figure since March. This reflects the impact of the lunar July holiday; as new models from major manufacturers roll out, tariff issues ease, and the Taiwanese stock market rebound boosts consumer momentum, dealers expect monthly sales to recover.

The market leader, Hwa Tai Motors (2207‑TW), believes that with strong domestic economic growth, buying momentum will gradually rebound, and new‑car registrations in September could rise to 34,000 units.

In August sales data, Hwa Tai Motors topped the top ten brands, taking first and second places with TOYOTA at 8,479 units (down 8.8% year‑over‑year) and LEXUS at 2,091 units (down 20%). Together they captured 36.2% of the market share, indicating relatively stable demand. TESLA, HONDA, BMW, and BENZ occupied positions three to six with sales of 1,737, 1,500, 1,281, and 1,270 units respectively.

Cumulative sales through August reached 270,156 units, maintaining a 2.4% year‑over‑year increase. Among the top ten manufacturers, TOYOTA delivered 83,597 units (up 2.4% year‑over‑year), HONDA 15,517 units (up 19.8%), TESLA 13,334 units (up 66.7%), MITSUBISHI 11,093 units (up 27%), and FORD 10,349 units (up 30.3%).
With the traditional Q4 peak season approaching, major manufacturers are launching new models. Taiwan Mercedes‑Benz announced that the all‑new Mercedes‑Benz S‑Class will debut on September 11.

Yurich Motors (2227‑TW) also announced that the Japan‑made, imported NISSAN X‑TRAIL e‑POWER will begin pre‑sales, bringing a new generation of Japanese aesthetics and continuing the core e‑POWER, VC‑TURBO, and e‑4ORCE electric‑drive technologies.

Pan‑Deng Yong‑Ying (2247‑TW) noted that BMW’s all‑electric iX3 has received a strong market response; since opening orders, sales have been brisk, and deliveries are expected to begin in the fourth quarter.

items.title: 中信00896配息1.45元刷新紀錄 年化配息率衝破20%
items.title_en: CTBC 00896 Dividend of NT$1.45 Sets New Record, Annualized Yield Breaks 20%
paras: 中國信託投信今(1)日公告，中信綠能及電動車ETF(00896-TW)最新一季收益分配，每受益權單位配發1.45元，刷新成立以來配息紀錄。以9月1日收盤價28.52元估算，單次配息率約5.08%，年化配息率達20.3%，將於9月16日除息，9月15日為最後買進日。
法人表示，今年以來台股漲勢強勁，科技族群表現尤為亮眼，加上目前正值上市櫃公司除權息旺季，企業獲利成長帶動股利發放水準提升，也使不少ETF得以配發更具吸引力的股息，進一步提升市場關注度。
中信綠能及電動車ETF成立於2021年，主要聚焦投資台灣綠能及電動車供應鏈相關企業，而相關供應鏈與AI產業鏈多有重疊，帶動ETF今年以來漲幅超過45%。除了鎖定綠能與電動車產業趨勢外，該ETF在成分股篩選上亦納入流動性、獲利能力及自由流通市值等指標，並採季配息機制，每年於2月、5月、8月及11月進行收益評價。
截至8月31日止，中信綠能及電動車ETF前十大持股權重合計超過50%，其中台積電為最大持股，占比約11%；其餘主要持股包括鴻海、南亞、台達電、光寶科、聯發科、緯創、中華電信、旺矽及研華等企業。
從持股結構來看，高度聚焦於AI、半導體、電子代工及電源管理等領域，同時兼具部分傳產配置，因此與其說是傳統綠能ETF，更接近一檔兼具「AI＋半導體＋電動車」概念的主題型ETF，在類股輪動環境下有助提升投資組合的韌性。
中信綠能及電動車ETF經理人張苡琤表示，未來台股成長主軸可望持續圍繞半導體、AI伺服器、智慧能源管理及電動車供應鏈等產業發展，而台積電、鴻海、台達電、聯發科及緯創等龍頭企業，憑藉技術優勢與全球供應鏈地位，可望持續扮演產業領軍角色。
張苡琤進一步指出，未來台股的關鍵已不僅是景氣循環，更在於能否掌握AI革命與能源轉型所帶來的結構性成長機會。在此背景下，以台積電、鴻海、台達電、聯發科及緯創等企業為核心的台灣科技供應鏈，仍有望成為推動台股中長期成長的重要引擎。

paras_en: CTBC Trust Investment announced today (the 1st) that the latest quarterly distribution for the CTBC Green Energy & Electric Vehicle ETF (00896‑TW) is NT$1.45 per unit, a record since its inception. Based on the September 1 closing price of NT$28.52, the one‑time dividend yield is about 5.08%, translating to an annualized yield of 20.3%. The ex‑dividend date is September 16, with the last purchase day on September 15.

Institutional investors noted that Taiwan’s stock market has surged strongly this year, especially the technology sector. Coupled with the current dividend‑distribution season for listed companies, rising corporate profits have boosted dividend payouts, allowing many ETFs to offer more attractive yields and further draw market attention.

The CTBC Green Energy & Electric Vehicle ETF was launched in 2021 and primarily invests in Taiwanese companies linked to the green energy and EV supply chains, which overlap considerably with the AI industry chain. This has helped the ETF gain more than a 45% gain year‑to‑date. In addition to targeting green energy and EV trends, the fund selects constituents based on liquidity, profitability and free‑float market cap, and follows a quarterly dividend schedule, evaluating earnings in February, May, August and November each year.

As of August 31, the ETF’s top ten holdings accounted for over 50% of its weight, with TSMC being the largest at roughly 11%. Other major holdings include Hon Hai, Nan Ya, Delta Electronics, Lite‑On Technology, MediaTek, Wistron, Chunghwa Telecom, WPG Holdings and Advantech.

Looking at the portfolio, it is heavily concentrated in AI, semiconductors, electronics manufacturing services and power management, while also holding some traditional industry stocks. Thus, rather than a conventional green‑energy ETF, it resembles a thematic fund that combines “AI + semiconductors + EV” concepts, which can enhance portfolio resilience amid sector rotation.

ETF manager Zhang Yicheng said that Taiwan’s growth drivers are expected to remain centered on semiconductors, AI servers, smart energy management and the EV supply chain. Leading firms such as TSMC, Hon Hai, Delta Electronics, MediaTek and Wistron, with their technological edge and global supply‑chain positions, are likely to continue leading their industries.

Zhang added that the key to Taiwan’s market future lies not only in economic cycles but in capturing the structural growth opportunities presented by the AI revolution and energy transition. In this context, the Taiwanese tech supply chain anchored by TSMC, Hon Hai, Delta Electronics, MediaTek and Wistron is expected to remain a major engine for medium‑ to long‑term market growth.

items.title_en: 27 Hundred‑Thousand Beneficiaries Celebrate as 00713 Shares Surge Above NT$62, Setting a New High; Quarterly Dividend Raised to NT$1.25
